watchlist_seed.thesis_short: Datacom transceiver mix shift toward 800G/1.6T optics for AI clusters may drive above-trend revenue growth and gross-margin recovery.
watchlist_seed.why_on_watchlist: Direct supplier into AI datacenter optical interconnect buildout; margin recovery story layered on top of a demand inflection.
watchlist_seed.key_confirmation_metric: Datacom/AI transceiver revenue growth rate and sequential gross-margin trend
watchlist_seed.key_invalidation_metric: Order softness, hyperscaler capex pause, or renewed pricing pressure in legacy transceiver lines
watchlist_seed.latest_material_change: MOCK: Most recent quarter showed sequential gross-margin expansion and management cited strengthening 800G order activity.

thesis.inflection_thesis: Rising AI data-center demand for higher-speed optical transceivers may improve utilization, revenue growth, and gross margin as product mix shifts toward 800G/1.6T.
thesis.confirmation_conditions: Two consecutive quarters of datacom segment revenue growth above corporate average, gross margin sequentially higher, and management reiterating or raising forward demand commentary.
thesis.invalidation_conditions: Datacom orders slow for two consecutive quarters, inventory rises industry-wide, a major hyperscaler customer publicly pulls back capex guidance, or gross margin compresses sequentially for two quarters.
thesis.key_risks: Customer concentration among a small number of hyperscalers; ASP pressure as competitors ramp 800G capacity; industrial/telecom segment remains a drag; execution risk integrating prior M&A.
